author: Zintenka
body:
Can we have an expansion of DTM-based YML so that we can make fully customizable monuments?

This should be it's format:

blue:
   spawn: -1040.5,61,1864.5,180,0
   title: Agaescents
   max: 40
   monuments:
      a:  
        name: R-Above
        min: 0,0,0
        max: -0,256,0
        height: 20
        radius: 20
        location: 0,0,0
        materials:
        - obsidian
        - endstone
        - smooth_brick   
  • You must only use "min" and "max" for a cuboid selection.
  • You must use "location" "radius" and "height" for a cylinder. 
  • You must use "location" and "radius" for a sphere. 
  • You can use "location" and "height" to create a monolith selection.
  • DO NOT use anything other than these as it might crash the game.
  • If you only use "height" and "radius" then the monument won't be verified. You need a "location" to base it on.
Fix TNT kill system:
TNT is verified as a person's kill when they set the TNT and it auto-ignites and when you shoot it from a bow. Can you bring back when you simply place TNT and ignite it via a redstone source (Cannons) and when you ignite it with another exploded TNT it registers as your kill? Why was this system booted?

Can you guys use this system to allow people to blow up monuments not made of obsidian or anything TNT-immune? This would be great for a "DTE" gamemode or "Destroy The Environment" gamemode.

TNT maps are becoming more common here and with testing events I'm trying to allow Avicus to adapt to TNT usage. We got to a small portion but it's not enough. I will post a TNT guide post soon with vids on different ways to use TNT.
